item.title: Other issue with a footway/pavement problem, 24th August
item.description:
Report received via Councillor: 'I have been contacted by a constituent who lives in Eldorado Road. They have advised that a public footpath outside 15 Eldorado Road, GL50 2PU has had barriers and closed footpath signs on it for nearly two years. They are unsure why nothing has happened and the barriers are still there'.. Please can you give me an update on what is happening to this area?
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: Vandalism on Kerbs, 24th August
item.description:
Hi, It looks like some Temu graffiti artist has gone around paint-rolling these yellow marks on the kerbs. It's clear that they're not official because they're unevenly-painted and the spacing between then has not been measured corroect, and is, instead, random. This is also the case on Clarence Road and Winchcome Street. In fact, these marks are appearing all over the town, so it seems that the vandal is quite prolific. Could you let me know when these will be removed and re-painted correctly, please?

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 49, Portland Street, Marle Hill, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: There are at least 5 adjacent drains at the junctions of Hewlett Road, All Saints Terrace and Ariel Lodge Road that are blocked resulting in the flooding in the attached photgraphs after only 10 mins of rain, 24th August
item.description:
All the drains adjacent to the junctions of Hewlett Road, All Saints Terrace and Ariel Lodge Road are not working. This is already an area identified as having a high risk of surface water flooding. The lack of basic maintenance over more than 20 years has resulted in the current situation, will it take the flooding of the lower ground floors of properties in this location before anything is done.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 148, Hewlett Road, Ewens Farm, Cheltenham, Cheltenham

item.title: Blockage of public pathway, 24th August
item.description:
The junction between Moorend Park Rd and Osprey Rd has a right of way leading to Allenfield Rd. This is being blocked as can be seen on the photos. This was reported at the beginning of August, No 70019315, and on 14 Aug I was advised that it was now closed. I contacted customer services on 20 Aug to complain and they advised I should use this path to resolve the issue as the problem is still ongoing as can be seen on these pictures.
